in_marathi.name: Bilash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu, Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bilash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bilash is derived from the Sanskrit and Hindu name Vishv, which means 'all pervading'. Bilash is a name that is often given to a boy as a reminder of the presence of Lord Vishnu and the idea of victory and success. It is a powerful and godly name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality.
